title: Build Excel template generator for premium seeder
description: Create a function that generates downloadable blank Excel templates (.xlsx) for each blok premium type. Templates include formatted header row with correct column names, a helper row with field descriptions, and pre-set column widths. Follows otherIncomesExcelService ExcelJS workbook generation pattern: title rows, header formatting (black bg, white fg), column width configuration.

files.change: Add new function generatePremiumTemplate(premiumType, inputType) that creates an ExcelJS workbook with one worksheet per premium type. Worksheet has: title row (merged cells) with premium name + period hint, formatted header row (bold, black bg, white fg) with correct column names from column mapping config, helper row (row 3) with field descriptions in gray italic, pre-set column widths, frozen header row, and data validation hints in comments.

implementation: Define PremiumTemplateOptions: premium_type, input_type (defaults from definition lookup), period_month, period_year (optional, for title)
Create generatePremiumTemplate(): init ExcelJS Workbook, addWorksheet with premium type name as sheet name
Add title row (row 1): merge cells A1-E1, set value to 'TEMPLATE PREMI {premium_type_name} - Periode: {month}/{year}', bold, font size 14, centered
Add header row (row 2): get column names from ColumnMappingConfig for this input_type, set each cell with border, black fill, white bold font
Add helper row (row 3): gray italic text describing each column (e.g., 'Masukkan kode karyawan (EmpCode)', 'Masukkan kode subblok'), row height 30
Set column widths: empcode=15, gang_code=12, subblok=15, jumlah=15, jenis=25
Freeze header row (freeze panes at row 3 so headers always visible)
Add data rows 4-100 with thin borders and number formatting (jumlah column as #,##0)
Add footer with generation date and 'Didukung oleh Sistem Daftar Upah PT Rebinmas'
Support multi-sheet generation: if premium_types array provided, each type gets its own sheet

reference.pattern: otherIncomesExcelService.ts ExcelJS workbook generation: title merge, header black bg/white fg, borders, column widths, signatures
reference.examples: otherIncomesExcelService.ts demonstrates addWorksheet, mergeCells for title, header row formatting with fill (black) + font (white bold), set column widths, row iteration with borders. Follow this pattern for template generation.

criteria: Generated template header row contains correct columns: EmpCode, Gang Code, Subblok, Jumlah, Jenis
Helper row (row 3) shows field descriptions in gray italic
Header row frozen so it remains visible during scroll
Multi-sheet generation produces one sheet per premium type with correct sheet names
Template opens correctly in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets

rationale.chosen_approach: Generate blank Excel templates with pre-filled headers and helper rows. Downloadable from API. Field operators fill data rows and re-upload. Reduces column order errors and eliminates guesswork about required columns.
alternatives_considered: Template as static file committed to repo
decision_factors: User experience: field operators need clear template, not documentation
Flexibility: dynamic generation ensures templates always match current column config
Error reduction: pre-filled headers eliminate column naming mistakes
rationale.tradeoffs: Adds maintenance burden if column config changes. Template format must stay in sync with column mapping config. Generating on-the-fly adds API latency (~50ms for single sheet, ~200ms for 7 sheets).

manual_checks: Download generated template for PREMI PRUNING and verify header columns match expected set
Open generated template in Excel, verify header frozen, helper row visible, formatting correct
Generate multi-sheet template for all 7 blok types, verify each sheet correct
success_metrics: Template .xlsx valid and opens in Excel without corruption warnings
All required columns present in header row with correct names
